subject: Tilling analysis shows a verbose message

messages.author: 790e074c50910616
messages.subject: Tilling analysis shows a verbose message
parts:
Hi, 
I am doing a tilling analysis on my data my code looks like:

library(methylKit)

file.list=list('ALS3.CG_noXY_report_v2.txt',
               'ALS4.CG_noXY_report_v2.txt',
               'ALS6.CG_noXY_report_v2.txt',
               'ALS7.CG_noXY_report_v2.txt',
               'ALS8.CG_noXY_report_v2.txt',
               'ACRI22.CG_noXY_report_v2.txt',
               'ACRI247.CG_noXY_report_v2.txt',
               'ACRI311.CG_noXY_report_v2.txt',
               'Prost018.CG_noXY_report_v2.txt'
)

myobj = methRead(location = file.list, sample.id = list("ALS3","ALS4","ALS6", "ALS7", "ALS8", "ACRI22", "ACRI247", "ACRI311","Prost018"), 
                  assembly = "hg19", dbtype = "tabix", pipeline = "bismarkCytosineReport",
                  header = FALSE, skip = 0, sep = "\t", resolution = "region", 
                  treatment = c(1,1,1,1,1,0,0,0,0), dbdir = "ALS_DB", mincov = 10, )

tile500 = tileMethylCounts(myobj, win.size=500, step.size=500, cov.bases = 0, mc.cores = 1)
tile500_filtered = filterByCoverage(tile500, lo.count = 10, lo.perc = NULL, hi.count = NULL, hi.perc = 99.9)
tile500_normalized = normalizeCoverage(tile500_filtered, method = "median")
tileMeth = unite(tile500_normalized)

I get the following message:

object has more than one sample id:  
 only one allowed
object has more than one sample id:  
 only one allowed
compressing the file with bgzip...
making tabix index...

checking wether tabix file already exists:
/Raw_data/shruti/methylation/temp/dragen_ALS/ALL_CG_reports/ALS_DB/Prost018_tiled.txt.bgz
tabix file is new.
continuing now ...

object has more than one sample id:  
 only one allowed
object has more than one sample id: 
''
''
and so on until it reads all the samples...

This happens, when I run the code line:
tile500 = tileMethylCounts(myobj, win.size=500, step.size=500, cov.bases = 0, mc.cores = 1)

Can you please let me know if this is just a regular verbose message or there is something that needs attention?

Thanks,

Shruti
